Dr Anne Childers
MBBS FRANZCOG
Consultant Obstetrician
Spirit Mother's Hospital
Stanley Street
South Brisbane

24/08/12                                                                                          Comment [OET1]: 2012

Dear Dr Childers,
Re: Mrs Jane Maclntyre, DOB: 01/03/73                                                             Comment [OET2]: 1973

I am writing to refer Mrs Maclntyre, an 8-week pregnant mother of 2 children, who has a history
of severe pre-eclampsia and a delivery by a Caesarian Section. She requires your further          Comment [OET3]: the introduction is not a
assessment, including her antenatal care and the delivery of her baby.                            place for details, especially history, you should
                                                                                                  expand your purpose later on the letter.
Today, Mrs Maclntyre reported her fifth pregnancy which she had confirmed by a home               Comment [OET4]: management: the care
pregnancy test kit and her LMP was on 26/6/12. She has been experiencing dysuria for the past     and delivery is management not assessment
3 days and a suspected UTI was diagnosed based on her urine test. Consequently, cefalexin         Comment [OET5]: 06/2012
250 mg, 4 times a day, was started and a midstream urine test was organized.
                                                                                                  Comment [OET6]: prescribed: “drug was
                                                                                                  prescribed” while “patient was started on”
Regarding her antenatal care, she was commenced on folic acid 400 micrograms daily till 12
                                                                                                  Comment [OET7]: until: till is informal
weeks of her pregnancy. In addition, tinzaparine 3500 units daily S/C was prescribed as she
                                                                                                                               th
has a positive family history for thrombosis. She was advised to undergo a scan for nuchal        Comment [OET8]: the 12 week: until
                                                                                                  followed by a point in time
translucency in order to rule out Down's Syndrome. In addition, information regarding the
Greenslopes Screening Centre was provided, and routine antenatal blood tests were ordered.        Comment [OET9]: syndrome


Mrs Maclntyre delivered her first child by an emergency Caesarean Section at 32 weeks as she
had developed severe pre-eclampsia. Please note that she is heterozygous for Factor V
Leiden.

Based on the above, your further assessment and management of Mrs Maclntyre's antenatal
care would be greatly appreciated.

Please do not hesitate to contact me if you have any queries.

Yours sincerely,
Doctor
